Show the object alone, centered and large against a plain opaque warm cream background; no other objects, no pet, no person, no scenery, no grass, no twig, no wooden token, no mud dots, no text, no border, no labels. Three-quarter shallow angle just enough to show it is a flattened stone. This is the specific small stone the pet brought home after trying it beside a twig, not a general scenic illustration. Crisp stepped pixel edges, approachable simplified game-item appearance, no photoreal texture.
